root_idea.summary: The root centers on stillness and cessation of movement, especially as realized in sleep.
root_idea.development: From physical stillness and sleep, usage extends to settled reassurance, dormancy or stagnation, worn condition, and objects associated with sleeping. These extensions are not all Quranic word senses.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized noun مَنَام.
Displayed under the singular active-participle citation form نَائِم rather than the Quranic plural.
Displayed as the ordinary verbal noun نَوْم.

senses.usage_conditions: In 39:42, the word occurs in the account of souls being taken during sleep; the supplied lexical discussion characterizes sleep in this setting as a temporary or light death, without making it actual death. In 8:43 and 37:102, contextual translations render the word as “dream,” referring to an experience associated with sleep.
The Quranic form is plural; the public headword is normalized to the singular active-participle citation form.

senses.definition: Sleep; bodily rest marked by suspension or stilling of ordinary activity.
senses.usage_conditions: The supplied Quran-focused discussion presents sleep as a light or lesser death in contrast with death as a heavy sleep; this is an explanatory characterization of the sleep state rather than a separate lexical sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who sleeps much; a habitual heavy sleeper.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived personal description, not a separate Quranic form in the supplied QAC groups.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An inconspicuous or little-regarded person, one whose mention is obscure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative personal use distinct from the sense “one who sleeps much.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become reassured, feel secure, or place confidence in someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the person or thing toward which one becomes at ease or trusting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment, cover, or quilt used for sleeping.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is named in relation to sleeping in or under it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The market became stagnant or inactive.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of stillness applied to a market that has ceased to move or trade normally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cloth became worn, threadbare, or old.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of the root for a garment whose condition has deteriorated through wear.

cautions: No Lane primary evidence was supplied; the broader Classical Arabic branches are retained only where explicitly attested in the supplied Mufradat and Maqayis entries.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The Quran Foundation glosses مَنَام in 8:43 and 37:102 as “dream,” but the supplied lexical discussion explicitly equates مَنَام with sleep and does not independently establish a separate lexical sense “dream.” These occurrences are therefore shown under the sleep sense with their contextual glosses.
